name: bgg-mcp
description: BoardGameGeek for your AI assistant: game details, collections, prices, recommendations and rules answers.
long_description:
BGG MCP connects Claude to [BoardGameGeek](https://boardgamegeek.com). Search for games, look up details, browse your collection, check the hotness list, compare prices across retailers, find similar games, spot trades with other users and answer rules questions from the BGG forums.

Most tools need BoardGameGeek authentication, so add an API key (or a cookie) when you install. Set your BGG username to say "my collection" instead of typing it each time.

Prices come from [BoardGamePrices.co.uk](https://boardgameprices.co.uk) and recommendations from [Recommend.Games](https://recommend.games).

tools.name: bgg-search
tools.description: Search for board games by name

tools.name: bgg-details
tools.description: Get details for one or more games: description, mechanics, player count, playtime, complexity and ratings

tools.name: bgg-collection
tools.description: Query a user's collection with filters for owned, wishlist, rated, played and more

tools.name: bgg-hot
tools.description: Get the current BoardGameGeek hotness list

tools.name: bgg-price
tools.description: Get current prices for games from multiple retailers

tools.name: bgg-trade-finder
tools.description: Find games one user owns that another user has on their wishlist

tools.name: bgg-recommender
tools.description: Get recommendations for games similar to a given game

tools.name: bgg-rules
tools.description: Answer rules questions from a game's BoardGameGeek rules forum

tools.name: bgg-thread-details
tools.description: Read a BoardGameGeek forum thread as plain text

bgg_api_key.title: BGG API Key
bgg_api_key.description: Recommended, as most tools need BoardGameGeek authentication. Request a key at https://boardgamegeek.com/applications

bgg_username.title: BGG Username
bgg_username.description: Your BoardGameGeek username, used when you say "me" or "my" (for example "show my collection")

bgg_cookie.title: BGG Cookie
bgg_cookie.description: Alternative to an API key, ignored when a key is set. Format: bggusername=user; bggpassword=pass; SessionID=xyz
